subject: CORRECTION: J+ meets 1-2alpha; cqr.ts clamp fixed fail-closed
body: CORRECTION from Downloads research corpus + live re-run. NFL Jackknife+ coverage 0.814 on n=7293 MEETS Barber 1-2a=0.80 at alpha=0.10 (width ratio 0.80 vs split). Previous MISSION_FAIL compared J+ to split 1-a=0.90 unfairly. New label: J+_meets_1-2alpha_not_strictly_better_than_split_1-alpha. FIX shipped: cqr.ts + conformal-calibration.ts no longer clamp conformal rank to n-1 (fake tightness); return +Infinity when k>n; cqrInterval fail-closed. cqr.test.ts rewritten; Python pin FAIL_CLOSED_QUANTILE_PY_PIN PASS; vitest BLOCKED on apps/web node_modules missing in worktree. CRPS baseline n=832 margins: MAE 4.49, CRPS_widened_gauss 3.86, CRPS_meanY 6.22 — kill line CRPS<3.85 for any density model. Research xlsx corpus has ZERO Jackknife+/CQR/Mondrior prior — live OOT governs; 2208.08598: split cal windows by season AND sport. Full: docs/ops/stats-lane/RESEARCH_LOOP_SOLUTIONS_2026-09-19.md
